why_a_sidecar: FUBO's standing rule (STATE.md, 2026-07-22) seals `dossier.json` until a post-combination re-assembly exists. This file is NOT that record: it is written beside it, the way a screen run's caveat rides beside its write-once manifest. `dossier.json` is untouched. `dossier.md` renders this block at the top, because a rendered view is not the record.
why_the_exception_serves_the_rule: The rule exists so FUBO cannot LOOK VALID while resting on a wrong share base. Every item below asserts a number is false. A marker that says 'do not trust these figures' cannot make the page look valid — it is the rule's purpose carried out by other means, not an exemption from it.
the_distinction: Each item is KNOWN-FALSE, not unknown. A gap is a number we do not have; an error is a number we have and can demonstrate is wrong. This page carries errors, and a reader who treats them as staleness will underestimate them.

items.known_false: `stock_info.shares_out` predates the combination, so every per-share figure and the market cap derived from it are wrong by the split factor.
items.evidence: STATE.md D6 — the 11.65x CIQ divergence on `shares_out`.
items.not_merely_stale: A stale share count drifts by buybacks. This one is wrong by a corporate action that reprices every per-share line on the page.

items.known_false: The dossier carries no multiple-floor verdict. FUBO's admission is not a valuation judgment and must not be read as one.
items.evidence: G3 returns NOT_EVALUATED where no multiple-vs-history is available; 282 of the 413 names reaching G3 in run 2026-07-29-03 are in that state.
items.not_merely_stale: Absence of a verdict reads as a passed verdict unless said out loud — item 22's visible-absence rule.

items.claim: The P/E caveat is text this code no longer produces.
items.known_false: `caveats[4]` asserts the multiple rests on normalized/adjusted earnings. The current code refuses to pick a denominator: it names both candidates and states that the displayed basis does not say which.
items.evidence: `mechanical.py` (d)-branch; audit P5 part 2. CNXC and SMPL carry the corrected form after re-assembly — FUBO cannot re-assemble, so it still carries the old one.
items.not_merely_stale: The sentence makes a claim about the denominator that the inputs do not support. It is wrong, not old.

items.claim: The same caveat contains a grammar defect: "EDGAR P/E 13.1x rest on".
items.known_false: Singular subject, plural verb — the verb was hardcoded while the pronoun switched on the number of multiples shown.
items.evidence: Live on CNXC, FUBO and SMPL, every one single-multiple. CNXC and SMPL were re-assembled after the fix; FUBO was not.
items.not_merely_stale: Cosmetic in isolation, but it is the visible marker that this page predates the fix — and it sits inside the sentence whose claim is also wrong.

items.claim: The document describes the PRE-COMBINATION entity throughout.
items.known_false: Assembled 2026-07-10 and containing no Hulu, no noncontrolling interest, no Newco, no Class B, and no reverse split — none of the structure that now defines the issuer.
items.not_merely_stale: This is not an out-of-date page about the same company. It is an accurate page about a company that no longer exists in that form.

what_this_page_can_still_be_used_for: the pre-combination entity's own history, read as history
the shape of the extraction as it stood on 2026-07-10
what_it_cannot_be_used_for: any per-share figure, market cap, or multiple
peer or cross-sectional comparison against post-combination names
evidence that the platform's defects are absent — the fixes exist in code and are simply not in this artifact
clears_when: A post-combination re-assembly exists. Until then this file stands and `dossier.json` stays sealed.
